LAREDO, Texas — Angel Gerardo Herrera was arrested Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 8:55 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail the same day on two alleged third-degree felony counts of harassment of a public servant, according to Webb County booking records.

Herrera was additionally booked on four misdemeanor charges: two counts of criminal mischief ($100–$750, Class B misdemeanor); resisting arrest, search or transport (Class A misdemeanor); and interference with public duties (Class B misdemeanor).

Bond had not been set on any of the charges as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record listed the city as Laredo, TX 78046; the arresting agency was not listed.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Angel Gerardo Herrera is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
